items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: Peek-coo, Peek-coo. I was behind his funeral and apparently had some people too.

ctx.x: You were telling us out at Millenberg they were playing the Carolina Moon Keeps Shining, I believe you said.

Yeah, Carolina. . . . Booms.... DING DING DING DING DING DING DING DING Booms.... That's where you could dance at a wall or you could dance at a shardies. But mostly, most of the people who always did dance were shardies or walls. That was the walls. And shardies, they used to take that for shardies too. You see the dance would have them to. But mostly, they all would have, mostly all of them, there was a few you would catch on the floor could dance at walls, could dance at a shardies. Now all the rest of them,…
We'll stop it. We can stop it.
